stem: A boy throws a ball upwards with velocity v<sub>0</sub> = 20 m/s. The wind imparts a horizontal acceleration of 4 m/s<sup>2</sup> to the west. The angle θ with the vertical the ball must be thrown so that the ball returns to the boy’s hand is?

assets.alt: A boy on the ground throws a ball along a line at angle θ to the vertical; a wind gives 4 to the west and g = 10 down, and their resultant a_net points down and west. Note: u must point opposite to a_net.
